_comment: Hand-picked exact Wikimedia Commons files per subject/topic, verified to load. This is the geography-pack method: the human chooses the file, the builder only renders it. Keys are subject slugs; values map a topic (must match data/figure-topics-curated.json) to the exact Commons filename. A topic absent here is simply not shipped (no good Commons diagram exists) rather than filled with a wrong auto-pick.

applied-sciences.semiconductor doping: Silicon doping - Type P and N.svg

environment-ecology.greenhouse effect diagram: Greenhouse effect with energy flows shown by altitude.svg

indian-archaeology-epigraphy.indus valley civilization map: Indus Valley Civilization, Mature Phase (2600-1900 BCE).svg

indian-demographics-census.india sex ratio census: 2011 Census sex ratio map for the states and Union Territories of India Boys to Girls 0 to 1 age group.svg
